description: This is a PHP test class for the EmploymentContractAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for various methods of the API, including retrieving, updating, and managing employment contract data and attachments. The tests utilize mocking frameworks to simulate database and service interactions, verifying expected behaviors and responses.

classes.name: EmploymentContractAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmploymentContractAPI, testing various API endpoints and behaviors in the OrangeHRM PIM module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup, truncates specific database tables for a clean state.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentContractService
methods.description: Tests that the API can retrieve an instance of EmploymentContractService.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that delete operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies validation rule retrieval for delete operation.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employment contract by employee number, with different scenarios for existing and non-existing contracts.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rules for fetching a single employment contract.

methods.name: testUpdateOnlyDates
methods.description: Tests updating only start and end dates of employment contracts for different employee numbers.

methods.name: updateOnlyDatesDataProvider
methods.description: Data provider supplying test cases for updating only dates.

methods.name: testUpdateNewContractAttachment
methods.description: Tests attaching a new contract file to an employment contract, including setting metadata.

methods.name: testUpdateNewContractAttachmentBadRequest
methods.description: Tests handling of bad requests when trying to update with invalid contract attachment data.

methods.name: testUpdateDeleteContractAttachment
methods.description: Tests deletion of current contract attachment.

methods.name: testUpdateReplaceContractAttachment
methods.description: Tests replacing existing contract attachment with a new one.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for updating employment contract info.

methods.name: setDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Sets up a mocked DateTimeHelperService returning a fixed date for testing.
